tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.description: Searches the arXiv API by topic and returns paper titles, authors, abstracts, and PDF links. No API key required.

query.description: Research topic or search query (e.g. graph neural networks, quantum computing)

max_results.description: Maximum number of papers to return (1-25, default 5)

tools.name: brave_search
tools.description: Queries the Brave Search REST API for privacy-first web results with titles, URLs, snippets and freshness filters, plus an optional AI summarizer key.

query.description: The web search query (e.g. 'model context protocol spec')

count.description: Number of results to return (1-20, default 5)

country.description: Two-letter country code used to localise results (default 'US')

search_lang.description: Language code for the returned results (default 'en')

freshness.description: Restrict results by age: 'pd' (24h), 'pw' (7d), 'pm' (31d), 'py' (1y) or a range like '2024-01-01to2024-06-30'

summary.description: Request an AI summarizer key alongside the results. Requires a Brave plan that includes the Summarizer (default false).

api_key.description: Brave Search subscription token. Reads BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY (or BRAVE_API_KEY) env var if omitted.

tools.name: chromadb_vector_query
tools.description: Runs read-only semantic similarity searches against a local persistent ChromaDB vector database. Accepts either natural-language text or a pre-computed embedding vector, supports metadata and document-content filters, and returns ranked matches with documents, metadata, raw distances and a normalised similarity score where higher is better.

query.description: Natural-language search text, embedded using the collection's own embedding function

collection.description: Name of the Chroma collection to search

db_path.description: Path to the persistent Chroma database directory

query_embedding.description: Pre-computed embedding vector. Use instead of 'query' when embeddings are generated externally; avoids loading an embedding model

tools.name: crewai_wrapper_demo
tools.description: Adapts any tool in this hub into a CrewAI tool automatically, generating a Pydantic args_schema from the tool's metadata.json and calling its run_tool(). Wraps a single tool or the entire catalogue, and reports what CrewAI tool a given hub tool would produce.

tool_name.description: Folder name of the hub tool to inspect, e.g. 'jwt_decoder'

tools_dir.description: Path to the hub's tools directory

tools.name: crypto_price_checker
tools.description: Fetches live cryptocurrency market prices, 24h change, and market cap in USD using the free CoinGecko API.

coin_id.description: Cryptocurrency ID (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana, dogecoin)

tools.name: crypto_price_tracker
tools.description: A tool to fetch the current price of cryptocurrencies using the CoinGecko API.

currency.description: The target currency to check the price in (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). Defaults to 'usd'.

tools.name: currency_converter
tools.description: Converts amounts between fiat currencies using free ECB exchange rates from the Frankfurter API (api.frankfurter.dev). No API key required.

from_currency.description: ISO 4217 source currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

to_currency.description: ISO 4217 target currency code (e.g. INR, JPY, CAD)

tools.name: discord_webhook_announcer_ts
tools.description: Sends Discord notifications and rich embed announcements through a Discord webhook URL.

color.description: Discord embed color represented as a decimal integer

tools.name: docker_container_status
tools.description: Queries the local Docker daemon and reports container status, healthcheck state, uptime, restart count, published ports and live resource statistics including CPU percentage, real memory usage, network and block I/O, and PID count. Read-only: never starts, stops or removes containers.

container.description: Name or ID of a single container to inspect. Omit to report all containers.

all_containers.description: Include stopped containers as well as running ones

include_stats.description: Collect CPU, memory, network and I/O statistics for running containers

limit.description: Maximum number of containers to report (1-200)

tools.name: duckduckgo_search
tools.description: Searches the web via DuckDuckGo and returns top search results including titles, snippets, and URLs.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default 5)

tools.name: gemini_embeddings
tools.description: Generate text embeddings for semantic search using the Google Generative AI Python SDK (Gemini API) or Vertex AI.

texts.description: Optional list of texts to embed in one call. If set, this is used instead of query.

task_type.description: One of: retrieval_query, retrieval_document, semantic_similarity, classification, clustering. Default: retrieval_document

title.description: Optional document title. Only used with task_type=retrieval_document.

tools.name: github_issue_pr_manager
tools.description: Lists repository issues and pull requests, and can create issues or comments via the GitHub REST API.

action.description: Action to execute: list_issues, list_pull_requests, get_issue, create_issue, create_issue_comment

repo.description: Repository in owner/repo format, e.g. tarunjandra/agent-tools-mcp-hub

state.description: Filter state for listing actions: open, closed, or all

per_page.description: Items per page for list actions (1-100)

include_pull_requests.description: For list_issues action, include PR-type items from issues endpoint

labels.description: Optional labels for create_issue action as a comma-separated string, e.g. bug,enhancement

issue_number.description: Issue or PR number for get_issue and create_issue_comment actions

github_token.description: Optional override token. Defaults to GITHUB_TOKEN env var.

tools.name: github_pr_code_review_diff_ts
tools.display_name: GitHub PR Code Review Diff Tool (TypeScript)
tools.description: Fetches changed files and patch details for an open GitHub pull request for automated code review workflows.

pull_request_url.description: Full GitHub pull request URL, for example https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123

owner.description: GitHub repository owner. Use with repo and pull_number when pull_request_url is omitted.

repo.description: GitHub repository name. Use with owner and pull_number when pull_request_url is omitted.

pull_number.description: GitHub pull request number. Use with owner and repo when pull_request_url is omitted.

token.description: Optional GitHub token. Reads GITHUB_TOKEN from the environment when omitted.

tools.name: github_pr_diff
tools.display_name: GitHub PR Code Review Diff Tool (TypeScript)
tools.description: Fetch diff files and patch details for any GitHub pull request to enable automated AI code reviews. Also retrieves review comments.

action.description: Action to perform: 'diff' to fetch changed files and patches, 'comments' to fetch review comments

include_patch.description: Include the unified diff patch content for each file (default true)

tools.name: github_pr_diff_ts
tools.display_name: GitHub PR Code Review Diff Tool (TypeScript)
tools.description: Fetches pull request metadata, per-file patches, and raw unified diffs from the GitHub REST API to enable automated AI code reviews. Handles pagination, patch truncation, and generated-file filtering so diffs fit inside an LLM context window.

action.description: Action to perform: 'metadata' for PR details, 'files' for per-file patches, 'diff' for the raw unified diff, or 'review_context' for an LLM-ready review payload

pr_url.description: Full pull request URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123. Supplying this overrides owner, repo, and pull_number.

owner.description: Repository owner or organization (required unless pr_url is supplied)

repo.description: Repository name (required unless pr_url is supplied)

pull_number.description: Pull request number (required unless pr_url is supplied)

max_files.description: Maximum number of changed files to return (1-300, default 100)

max_patch_chars.description: Maximum characters kept per file patch before truncation (200-100000, default 6000)

max_diff_chars.description: Maximum characters kept for the raw diff when action is 'diff' (500-1000000, default 100000)

include_patch.description: Include the unified patch body for each file. Set false for a lightweight file-name-only summary.

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to skip. Defaults to lockfiles and minified assets so generated churn does not consume the model's context.

github_token.description: GitHub personal access token. Falls back to the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable. Optional for public repositories.

tools.name: github_repo_info
tools.description: Fetches public metadata for any GitHub repository — stars, forks, primary language, open issues, license, topics and description — using the public GitHub REST API. No API key required (an optional GITHUB_TOKEN raises the rate limit).

tools.name: github_repo_stats_ts
tools.description: Fetches public GitHub repository statistics (stars, forks, watchers, open issues, license, topics, last push) together with recent release history including tags, publish dates, asset counts and total download counts. Uses the public GitHub REST API, no API key required (an optional GITHUB_TOKEN raises the rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour). TypeScript implementation.

repo.description: Repository in 'owner/repo' format, e.g. 'tarunjandra/agent-tools-mcp-hub'. A full GitHub URL is also accepted.

action.description: Which data to return: 'stats' for repository metrics, 'releases' for release history, 'all' for both

limit.description: Number of releases to return (1-30, default 5)

tools.name: google_custom_search
tools.description: Searches the web via Google's Custom Search JSON API and returns the top matching links with titles and snippets.

num.description: Number of results to return (1-10, default 5)

api_key.description: Google Cloud API key. Reads GOOGLE_CSE_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY) if omitted.

cx.description: Programmable Search Engine ID. Reads GOOGLE_CSE_ID if omitted.

tools.name: hackernews_profile
tools.description: Fetches HackerNews user profiles with karma, creation date, and submission count. Also retrieves top stories with scores and comment counts.

action.description: Action to perform: 'profile' for user profile, 'top' for top stories

limit.description: Number of top stories to return (default 10)

tools.name: hackernews_profile_ts
tools.description: Fetches HackerNews user profiles with karma, creation date, and submission count. Also retrieves top stories with scores and comment counts. TypeScript implementation.

action.description: Action to perform: 'profile' for user profile, 'top' for top stories

limit.description: Number of top stories to return (default 10)

tools.name: jira_ticket_status_fetcher
tools.description: Fetch the status, summary, and description of a Jira ticket using the Jira Cloud REST API.

query.description: Jira issue key, for example PROJ-123

tools.name: jwt_decoder
tools.description: Decodes JSON Web Tokens (JWT) and Base64Url strings to inspect header, payload claims, and expiration status without requiring private keys.

token.description: The JWT token string or base64url encoded string to decode

tools.name: langchain_wrapper_demo
tools.description: A demo tool configuration used for verifying external LangChain framework tool wrapper integration examples.
tools.author: govardhanreddyg2005-byte

query.description: The search query or input string to process

count.description: The number of results to return

tools.name: open_meteo_weather
tools.description: Fetches current weather and a 7-day forecast for any city using the free, zero-auth Open-Meteo API.

city.description: City or place name to look up (e.g. London, Tokyo, New York)

forecast_days.description: Number of forecast days to return (1-16, default 7)

tools.name: pdf_text_extractor
tools.description: Extract plain text from local PDF files using pypdf.

file_path.description: Path to the local PDF file

tools.name: postgres_query_runner
tools.description: Execute parameterized, read-only SQL queries against a PostgreSQL database using psycopg2, with query validation, session-level read-only enforcement, and structured tabular results.

query.description: SQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT, WITH, EXPLAIN, SHOW, or TABLE

params.description: Optional list of positional parameters for parameterized SQL execution

connection_string.description: Optional PostgreSQL DSN/connection string. Falls back to POSTGRES_DSN, DATABASE_URL, or POSTGRES_HOST/PORT/DB/USER/PASSWORD environment variables

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: 100)

returns.description: Query execution result containing columns, rows as key-value objects, row_count, execution_time_ms, and status

tools.name: public_holiday_lookup
tools.description: Retrieves public holiday dates for an ISO country code and calendar year using the free Nager.Date API.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as US or CA.

year.description: Calendar year to query. Defaults to the current year.

include_subdivisions.description: Include ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes when the holiday applies only to part of a country.

tools.name: qr_code_generator
tools.description: Generates QR code images from URLs or text strings and returns them as base64-encoded PNG data. Supports configurable size and error correction levels.

data.description: The text, URL, or data to encode into a QR code

size.description: Size of the QR code image in pixels (default 256)

error_correction.description: Error correction level: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), H (30%). Default M

tools.name: redis_key_value_store
tools.description: Get and set cached values in a Redis instance with optional TTL expiration.

action.description: Redis operation to perform: get or set

value.description: Value to store when action is set

ttl.description: Optional expiration time in seconds when action is set

tools.name: rss_feed_reader
tools.description: Parses any RSS or Atom feed URL and returns the latest articles with titles, links, summaries, and publish dates. No API key required.

feed_url.description: Full HTTP or HTTPS URL of the RSS or Atom feed

max_results.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1-25, default 5)

tools.name: sendgrid_email_dispatcher
tools.description: Send plain-text or HTML emails to recipients using the SendGrid API.

query.description: Plain-text or HTML email body content

html.description: Send the body as HTML when true; plain text when false

tools.name: slack_notifier
tools.description: Sends rich markdown notifications and webhook alerts directly to Slack channels.

webhook_url.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL (or reads SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL env var)

tools.name: spotify_player
tools.description: Fetch the currently playing track and the user's private/public playlists from Spotify.

limit.description: Maximum number of playlists to return (default 10)

tools.name: sqlite_query_runner
tools.description: Execute parameterized SQL queries, inspect table schemas, and fetch structured tabular results from SQLite databases safely with configurable read-only safeguards.

database_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3)

query.description: SQL query to execute (e.g. SELECT, PRAGMA table_info, EXPLAIN)

params.description: Optional list or tuple of positional parameters for parameterized SQL execution

read_only.description: Enforce read-only mode to prevent write/destructive operations (default: true)

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: 100)

allowed_roots.description: Optional directory allowlist for database_path containment. Defaults to SQLITE_ALLOWED_ROOTS or the process cwd.

returns.description: Query execution result containing columns, rows as key-value objects, row_count, execution_time_ms, and status

tools.name: supabase_table_query
tools.description: Query and insert rows in a Supabase Postgres table using @supabase/supabase-js. Supports column selection, filtering, ordering, and pagination.

action.description: Action to perform: 'query' to read rows or 'insert' to add a row

table.description: Name of the Supabase table to query or insert into

columns.description: Comma-separated column names to select (default '*' for all columns)

filters.description: Array of filter objects with column, operator (eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, in), and value

order_by.description: Column name to order results by

ascending.description: Sort order: true for ascending, false for descending (default true)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-1000, default 50)

offset.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination (default 0)

row.description: Row data to insert (required when action is 'insert')

tools.name: telegram_bot_sender
tools.description: Send agent alerts and text messages to Telegram chats using the Telegram Bot API.

chat_id.description: Telegram chat, group, or channel ID

tools.name: telegram_notifier
tools.description: Sends text messages, alerts, and Markdown/HTML notifications to Telegram chats or channels via Telegram Bot API.

message.description: The text message content to send to Telegram (supports Markdown or HTML formatting)

chat_id.description: Target Telegram Chat ID or Channel username (e.g., '@mychannel' or '123456789'). Reads TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env var if omitted.

bot_token.description: Telegram Bot Token from @BotFather. Reads TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var if omitted.

parse_mode.description: Message formatting mode ('Markdown', 'MarkdownV2', or 'HTML'). Defaults to 'Markdown'.

disable_web_page_preview.description: Whether to disable link previews in the sent message (default false).

tools.name: trello_card_creator
tools.description: Create task cards in specified Trello lists using the Trello REST API.

query.description: Title or name of the Trello card

list_id.description: ID of the Trello list where the card should be created

description.description: Optional description for the Trello card

tools.name: twilio_sms_alert
tools.description: Sends critical SMS alert notifications via the Twilio Programmable Messaging API for agent workflows.

message.description: SMS body text to send (max 1600 characters)

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567). Reads TWILIO_TO_NUMBER if omitted.

from.description: Twilio sender phone number in E.164 format. Reads TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER if omitted.

account_sid.description: Twilio Account SID. Reads TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID if omitted.

auth_token.description: Twilio Auth Token. Reads TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN if omitted.

tools.name: twitter_x_post_creator_ts
tools.description: Create automated text posts using the X API v2.

text.description: Text content of the X post

tools.name: wikipedia_search
tools.description: Searches Wikipedia and returns clean extract summaries, page titles, and canonical URLs for agent knowledge retrieval.

query.description: Topic or title to search on Wikipedia

sentences.description: Number of summary sentences to return (default 3)

tools.name: yahoo_finance
tools.description: A tool to fetch current stock quotes and basic company info using Yahoo Finance.
